item: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, 4 GB - control server, Wi-Fi, head displays, audio
notes: Powered from the 5 V regulator through a USB-C plug breakout (J12), not from a wall adapter. Needs the 32 GB microSD SD1.

item: Adafruit KB2040 (RP2040) - motor and NeoPixel controller
notes: Powered and commanded from a Pi USB 2.0 port over cable J11. Revision D uses all 20 GPIOs, including GP12/GP13 on the STEMMA QT connector; the pin map is fixed by firmware/kb2040/code.py (docs/firmware.md section 4).

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 1, left foot (lf-front, lf-rear)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U6. Keep both 0.2 ohm sense resistors: 1 A per motor. Revision D: jumper AIN1 to BIN1 and AIN2 to BIN2 on the board so one KB2040 pin pair drives both motors of the foot, D2 (AIN1+BIN1) and D3 (AIN2+BIN2); SLP tied to KB2040 3V3.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 2, right foot (rf-front, rf-rear)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U7. Revision D: jumper AIN1 to BIN1 and AIN2 to BIN2 on the board so one KB2040 pin pair drives both motors of the foot, D6 (AIN1+BIN1) and D7 (AIN2+BIN2); SLP tied to KB2040 3V3.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 3, centre foot (cf-front, cf-rear)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U6. Revision D: jumper AIN1 to BIN1 and AIN2 to BIN2 on the board so one KB2040 pin pair drives both motors of the foot, MOSI (AIN1+BIN1) and D10 (AIN2+BIN2); SLP tied to KB2040 3V3.

item: DRV8833 dual H-bridge - driver 4, head friction drive (channel A only)
notes: VMOTOR from the 6 V regulator U7. BIN1/BIN2 tied to GND; BOUT1/BOUT2 unused. Revision D: AIN1 = KB2040 D4, AIN2 = D5; SLP tied to KB2040 3V3.

item: Pololu D36V50F5 step-down regulator, 12 V to 5 V 5.5 A - Pi, displays, NeoPixels, amplifier
notes: Fed from the 12 V bus through fuse F3 (3 A). Pololu stock is rationed; order early.

item: Pololu D36V50F6 step-down regulator, 12 V to 6 V 5.5 A - motor rail A (drivers U1 and U3)
notes: Fed from the 12 V bus through fuse F4 (5 A). Four motors x 1 A limit = 4 A worst case.

item: Pololu D36V50F6 step-down regulator, 12 V to 6 V 5.5 A - motor rail B (drivers U2 and U4)
notes: Fed from the 12 V bus through fuse F5 (5 A). Three motors x 1 A limit = 3 A worst case. Revision D: also feeds release servos SV1 and SV2 (3 A stall budget, only while the ground and dome motors are refused).

item: PAM8302 mono class D amplifier, 2.5 W into 4 ohm - dome and body sound
notes: Runs on the 5 V rail. Input is the Pi 3.5 mm jack, left and right summed through two 10 k resistors (R4).

item: ADS1115 16 bit 4 channel ADC, STEMMA QT - battery voltage sense
notes: Address 0x48 on the Pi I2C-1 bus, single-ended input A0, read by firmware/pi/battery.py. Divider R2 (100 k top) over R3 (15 k bottom).

item: Adafruit DRV8871 brushed DC motor driver breakout - 12 V centre-leg actuator (revision D)
notes: VM from the 12 V bus through F7 (2 A). IN1 = KB2040 D8, IN2 = D9. Replace the factory 30 k ILIM resistor with R5 (71.5 k): 0.895 A limit against the actuator's 1.0 A stall. Terminal blocks pre-soldered.

item: 4-channel bi-directional logic level converter, BSS138 - release servo signals 3.3 V to 5 V (revision D)
notes: LV = KB2040 3V3, HV = U5 5 V. Channel 1: D0 to SV1, channel 2: D1 to SV2; channels 3 and 4 unused. 10 k pull-ups on both sides.

Page reads Out of stock on 2026-09-12; a generic MG995 is listed by ProtoSupplies (MOT-22) at $6.95.
